## CreateGameOptions  (type-only)
interface CreateGameOptions<A extends string, S extends FlushableSave | null = null> {
    root: HTMLElement;
    title?: string;
    design?: {
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
    surface?: Omit<SurfaceOptions, 'logicalWidth' | 'logicalHeight'>;
    post?: PostSettingsPatch;
    aux?: SceneTargetAux;
    particles?: ParticleSystemOptions;
    host?: Host;
    save?(host: Host): S;
    sim?: SimOption;
    mixerKey?: string;
    input: {
        bindings: Bindings<A>;
        globalKeys?: Iterable<string>;
        buttonKeys?: Iterable<string>;
        blocked?: () => boolean;
        getGamepads?: () => readonly (GamepadLike | null)[];
        magnify?: MagnifyOptions;
        record?: boolean;
        replay?: InputRecording;
    };
    styles?(doc: Document): void;
    layout?: LayoutSpec;
    onGpuReady?(gpu: GpuContext): void;
    blockBrowserZoom?: boolean;
    forceUnsupported?: boolean;
    xr?: XrOptions;
}

## EngineCtx  (type-only)
interface EngineCtx<A extends string = string, S extends FlushableSave | null = FlushableSave, C = unknown> {
    readonly design: {
        readonly width: number;
        readonly height: number;
    };
    readonly surface: Surface;
    readonly gpu: GpuContext;
    readonly renderer: Renderer;
    readonly camera: Camera;
    readonly post: PostStack;
    readonly particles: ParticleSystem;
    readonly input: Input<A>;
    readonly clock: TickClock;
    replay(recording: InputRecording, opts?: ReplayOptions): GameReplay;
    readonly gestures: Gestures;
    readonly pointers: PointerRouter<unknown>;
    readonly padNav: PadNav;
    readonly audio: AudioEngine;
    readonly ui: Overlay;
    readonly host: Host;
    readonly save: S;
    readonly stack: SceneStack<C, Frame, Camera>;
    readonly loop: GameLoop;
    readonly hooks: GameHooks;
    onDeviceLost(fn: (info: GPUDeviceLostInfo) => void): () => void;
    readonly xr: XrControl;
}

## FlushableSave  (type-only)
interface FlushableSave {
    flush(): void;
}

## GameHooks  (type-only)
interface GameHooks {
    update?(dt: number): void;
    frame?(dt: number): void;
    beforeRender?(time: Time): void;
    afterRender?(time: Time): void;
    hide?(reason: HideReason): void;
    show?(reason: ShowReason): void;
    lifecycle?(state: HostLifecycleState): void;
    deviceLost?(info: GPUDeviceLostInfo): void;
}

## GameReplay  (type-only)
interface GameReplay extends InputPlayback {
    stop(): void;
}

## HideReason  (type-only)
type HideReason = 'hidden' | 'pagehide' | 'freeze';

## ReplayOptions  (type-only)
interface ReplayOptions extends Pick<InputPlaybackOptions, 'speed' | 'tickMs'> {
    onEnd?(): void;
}

## ShowReason  (type-only)
type ShowReason = 'visible' | 'pageshow' | 'resume';

## SimOption  (type-only)
type SimOption = {
    step?: number;
} | false;

## XrControl  (type-only)
interface XrControl {
    supported(): Promise<boolean>;
    enter(): Promise<void>;
    exit(): Promise<void>;
    readonly active: boolean;
    readonly session: XRSession | null;
    readonly surface: XrSurface | null;
}

## XrOptions  (type-only)
interface XrOptions {
    referenceSpace?: 'local-floor' | 'local' | 'viewer';
    onEnter?(session: XRSession): void;
    onExit?(): void;
}

## createGame
function createGame<A extends string, S extends FlushableSave | null = null, C = unknown>(opts: CreateGameOptions<A, S>): Promise<EngineCtx<A, NoInfer<S>, C> | null>;
